Foundations I bring to every session

Practical change

I prioritize skills and experiments you can use between sessions so therapy becomes a bridge to daily life.

Curious partnership

We work collaboratively — your expertise about your life paired with my clinical framing and tools.

Clear structure

Sessions have a predictable arc: check-in, focus work, skill practice, and next-step planning.

Approaches and modalities I use

Cognitive-behavioral tools

Practical strategies to shift thinking patterns and reduce symptoms.

Trauma-informed care

Gentle pacing and safety-first interventions when trauma history is present.

Internal systems & meaning work

Exploring inner parts and values-based goals to build sustainable change.

Specialized modalities

Modalities: {{MODALITIES}} — integrated to match your needs.

Questions people often have before reaching out

Do you take insurance?

I currently offer private-pay options and can provide a superbill for out-of-network reimbursement. If insurance is essential, I can offer referrals to clinicians in-network.

How long does therapy take?

Some clients come for short, intensive blocks; others prefer ongoing weekly work. We'll co-design a plan based on your goals.

Can I meet remotely?

Yes. Telehealth is available across approved states. In-person options are offered in {{CITY}} when appropriate.

What clients have noticed

"I came in exhausted and stuck. Within weeks I had tools I used at work and home. The change felt real."

— A.S., 36

"Warm, direct, and practical. Sessions gave me structure for decisions I’d been avoiding."

— M.T., 29

Free guide: a 5-step reset for overwhelmed days

A short, actionable PDF you can use the next time you feel burned out. Practical steps, journaling prompts, and a brief breathing protocol.

Or email {{EMAIL}} with "Guide" in the subject.

Confidentiality & privacy: Sessions are confidential within legal and ethical limits. I will discuss limits of confidentiality, record-keeping, and data protection during intake.

Crisis disclaimer: If you are in immediate danger or experiencing a crisis, please call local emergency services or a crisis line. I do not provide crisis services via email.

Scope & boundaries: I provide outpatient psychotherapy for adults. I do not offer forensic assessments, prescriptions, or emergency services. If a referral is needed, I will assist you with resources.
